description:
(Paid; not available through MCP.) Same input as analyze_label, but each detected substance carries the cross-axis derivation.
This tool does not return that data: it returns the HTTP endpoint (POST /v1/labels/analyze/diff with the same JSON body, 0.01 USDC per request via x402 on Base) to call instead.

axis.description: Regulatory axis the label or name belongs to: JP, EU or US.

lang.description: Language of the name or label text (ISO 639-1), e.g. ja, en, de, fr.

text.description: The additive (or whole ingredient) section of one label: one raw string (split at 、 , ， / for Japanese and , ; . : for Latin script, at bracket depth zero; whitespace is not a separator), or an array of already-split items (tokens[i] corresponds to item i).

name: analyze_label_diff
title: Find the additives named on a label, with the cross-axis derivation (paid, HTTP only)
